analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 탈출 + MACD 개선 지속
analysis.reason: RSI 46.4에서 56.4로 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 299.4045에서 1542.7845로 개선 지속. 5일 전 저가 102,825원 대비 현재가 116,975원으로 Higher Low 패턴 형성 중. 3거래일 연속 관망 후 매수 전환.

· Position vs SMA100/200 (142,453/108,052 KRW): attempting recovery after entering mid-long term downtrend.
· 52-week position (39.2%) + current price level significantly above historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]

· MACD histogram trajectory (299.4045→1542.7845) + continued improvement, signaling bullish expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band at 108,097 KRW) + 21.13% band width indicating potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]

· Swing resistance (120,015 KRW) + potential for strengthening uptrend upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low) + interpreting a recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.77x) + moderate confidence in current price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + buy entry conditions met.
